reviews.text:
A great crepe restaurant that hits all the marks when it comes to taste. Normally, I would never have gone into this store after seeing its interior. However, in Hongdae, a place filled with all kinds of hip images, the boldness of not caring about interior design, and the fact that there were only a few tables of customers despite the exterior somehow created a sense of challenge.

Ordering is done through a kiosk, and there are gelato, crepes, and drink menus. I ordered a gelato crepe (5,000 won), which comes with Nutella as standard, and you can choose the gelato you want. It comes in flavors such as yogurt, chocolate, strawberry, mango, cookie, and mint chocolate, and you can add whipped cream or almonds. I chose strawberry gelato and after waiting a few minutes, the crepe came out.
The fresh strawberry gelato and Nutella went well with the thin, crispy yet soft crepe batter. Despite the interior design, there was a reason why people kept coming into the store.
I felt very proud of having a sense of challenge.

This day was a very clear and cloudy day early in the morning, so I took pictures of the clouds, but I wanted to go there with some time left on the way to Jinjin Gayeon. When I looked at the list, I saw Gelateria Etta here, so I decided not to eat gelato anymore, but it was highly rated and seemed like an easy menu before dinner, so I decided to try it as a last resort.

As I entered the white and mint-colored store, I couldn't see the owner, probably because he was working in the back kitchen, but when he sensed that he was popular, he appeared from the back kitchen.

Please recommend a menu, so please choose the Pistachio Pumpkin Seed and Raspberry & Coconut options instead of the ones that are sold out.

After putting the gelato in a cup, scoop out the pumpkin seeds and coconut separately with a spoon.

Sitting at a bar table on one side of the store, I first tasted the Pistachio Pumpkin Seed, which seemed to have a milder taste, and it tasted similar to what I've tasted at other stores. When I tasted the Raspberry & Coconut, I expected it to have raspberry chunks or something a bit more refreshing, but that wasn't the case, and the coconut was just dried coconut chips, so rather than having a harmonious taste coming together, it felt like I was eating raspberry gelato and dried coconut chips separately, so I wasn't impressed.

Still, after saying goodbye and saying that I had a good meal, I left Gagel.

Overall, other than Ricotta Cheese & Pear and Earl Gray, which I liked after tasting a few flavors at Epicure, I didn't really have any memorable tastes from the other gelato shops I've been to so I decided I shouldn't go to any more gelato shops. However, since it was nearby and I had some time left, I stopped by Gelateria Etta, which has a high rating, but unlike at Epicure, I wasn't that impressed because I couldn't taste it and chose it. It was similar to the stores, so it was said to be delicious considering the island of Hyeongpyeong.

Now that I think about it, I think I should visit Epicure again.

Yeonnam dessert restaurant Puhaha Cream Bread 6-piece set nice and sweet

I went to Puhaha Cream Bread, a dessert restaurant in Yeonnam. It is close to exit 3 of Hongik University subway station. It's not overly sweet or greasy. It's been a while since I walked around Yeontral Park. The weather is nice and there are a lot of people even on a weekday afternoon. I went to this place because I wanted to eat delicious bread. On the exterior it says PUHAHA. It is also written in English, and I wonder what foreigners will think when they see FUHAHA. There is a plaque saying that the cream bread was featured on the SBS Master of Living program.

When you enter, there are samples of cream bread on display. I cut a cross section and the cream was very rich. If you take a big bite, it will fill your mouth. Looking at the explanation, I saw that the patented small amount of cream salt has significantly reduced the sugar and greasiness, and you can enjoy the savory milk taste unique to animal-based fresh cream. I understood that they used high-quality cream, not cheap cream. It's a master's cream bread, so it looks good.

There is a 5-piece set and a 6-piece set, but I chose 6. I wanted to try different flavors. The flavors range from salt cream bread, real strawberry, Jeju matcha, Greek yogurt, less sweet red bean, and matcha sweet red bean. Among these, I was most curious about the taste of matcha. When I was young, I didn't know that matcha was delicious, but these days, I really like matcha. Since it is sold individually, it would be nice to stop by Puhaha Cream Bread, a famous dessert restaurant in Yeonnam, while walking along Gyeongui Line Forest Trail. There is an autograph saying that Stay C and comedian Ji Seok-jin also visited.

When you cut a section, you can smell the aroma. Strawberry cream bread is made with real strawberries, giving it a subtle flavor. The unique refreshing and fresh taste of strawberries is excellent. The matcha cream bread is rich with about 4% Jeju organic matcha. It has a bitter taste, but it's exactly what I wanted. Greek yogurt cream bread actually contains Greek yogurt, so it is thick and goes well with whipped cream. Less sweet red bean cream bread tastes like sweet red beans with a little less sugar, so you can enjoy it healthily. Puhaha Cream Bread is a dessert restaurant in Yeonnam that is serious about cream bread.

I ate it at home with my partner, then took it to work and ate it with my colleagues. Everyone complimented me on how delicious it was and how well I brought it. It was Puhaha Cream Bread, a famous dessert restaurant in Yeonnam that is good as a snack or a light meal.

reviews.author: Chanwook Lee
reviews.text:
A franchise book cafe operated in collaboration with a famous Paris patisserie, you can taste high-quality French desserts with iced Americano. There are three locations in Korea, including Hongdae, Yeouido, and Songdo.

I found the Donggyo branch located at the beginning of Gyeongui Line Forest Road, in front of Exit 3 of Hongik University Station. In the case of the Donggyo branch, the location is very good and, unlike nearby cafes, it is quite large and seems to be used as a meeting place.

A variety of breads and desserts are on display in the showcase, from classic to simple Viennoiserie. The build quality is as good as you would see in Paris, but the price is also quite expensive.

After careful consideration, I ordered Paris Brest, one of the signature desserts, and Millefeuille Vanilla, which is only sold in limited quantities per day at the store. For coffee, I had iced Americano since there was no aromatherapy agent.

Paris Brest is a choux made with praline cream to commemorate the bicycle race from Paris to Brest. Since the praline cream is nut-based, the sweetness felt heavy.
​
The texture was so smooth that it seemed like a luxurious peanut butter, and it was so sweet that I had coffee dripping into it every time I took a bite. Highly recommended if you usually prefer sweet and savory desserts.

The pastry of mille-feuille was much thinner than that of regular mille-feuille, so the shape was almost crushed when cut. The thick vanilla cream filled between the pastries was good, but the pastry was not good.

This is a place you must visit when you have something nearby, such as a date at Hongdae or an outing along Gyeongui Line Forest Trail in Yeonnam. It’s the mecca of bagels! In addition to bagels, we also offer a variety of desserts, including cookies and financiers. I bought medicine, cream cheese cookies, a corn bagel, and a basic plain bagel.

There are some that catch your eye, such as fig financiers, earl gray lemon cream cheese cookies, and pollack roe bagels. It looks very delicious and I will definitely have it on my next visit. The packaging box is pretty. It has a yellow box, a bagel character, and the Eiffel Tower in Paris. It is a visual that captures the hearts of both women and men. I was very satisfied with the corn bagel and cream cheese cookie I chose. You can feel the corn kernels embedded in the bagel and the cream inside is harmonious. reviews.author: Kim Dol Hareubang
reviews.text:
This is a South African restaurant located in Yeonnam-dong. This restaurant, run by Itaewon's Braai Republic, specializes in meat pies and sausage rolls. It is in the same building as Bistro Yeonnam, and Pie Republic is located on the first basement level. The inside of the store is small, and it seemed like all the tables were managed by one server. You must also drink your own water.
This time, we visited with 4 people and ordered 'The Really Ridiculous' which comes with 3 pies, 3 lamb ribs, 2 sausage rolls, and 3 sides. For the 3 pies, I chose 'LAMB PIE, PEPPER STEAK PIE, LENTIL&MUSHROOM PIE', for the 2 sausage rolls I chose 'CHORIZO, CHICKEN&MUSHROOM', and for the 3 sides I chose 'Fries, Green Salad, Mash Potatoes'. The food was served on a platter a little while after ordering.
Among the pies I ordered, I tried the LAMB PIE first. The pie was filled with thickly sliced ​​meat, and the scent of lamb was subtle and not overpowering. The lamb meat was soft and chewy without feeling dry, and went well with the pie and meat filling. LENTIL&MUSHROOM PIE was a vegetarian pie, and the texture of the finely chopped mushrooms was especially good, and the combination of tomatoes, mirepoix, and lentils was good. PEPPER STEAK PIE didn't really impress me, but since I really like pepper, I enjoyed the beef pie, which had a strong peppery scent and taste.
Among the sausage rolls, I tried CHICKEN&MUSHROOM first. Here too, the texture of the finely chopped mushrooms was good, and the spiciness of the cayenne pepper between the chicken and mushrooms added a nice change to the taste. CHORIZO was a sausage roll with pork and spicy sauce, and CHORIZO went very well with Mash Potatoes, so I enjoyed it with Mash Potatoes.
Three lamb ribs were provided, and among the menu items I ate that day, the lamb ribs were the most delicious. I liked the meat that wasn't tough and the subtle scent of the lamb, and when I dipped the steak in the gravy sauce, I felt like the gravy sauce enhanced the taste of the lamb even more. It was a pity that I didn't order one more lamb rib.
It's near the Gyeongui Line Forest Road in Yeonnam-dong, so it's not bad for accessibility and the route isn't complicated, but overall, it was disappointing that the portions were small for the price and that it took a while for the food to come out. However, I was able to enjoy the fairly generous amount of side dishes (Mash Potatoes, Green Salad) and the light taste and aroma of the lamb. If you want to experience South African food in Hongdae or Yeonnam, it would not be a bad choice to try South African food here.

reviews.text:
A unique experience in an unmanned store. The atmosphere inside the store is nice and it opens early in the morning, which helps with dining options.
I took a leisurely break inside the store on a quiet morning, and the music and the store atmosphere went well with it.
There is a self-service beverage bar, and after ordering, the pick-up window number appears and a bell rings. If you knock on the pick-up box with the receipt barcode, a message will appear.
Perhaps because it was early in the morning, it was clean and tidy.

reviews.author: Dongho Choi_Bryan
reviews.text: Lotteria is in front of Exit 1 of Hongik University Station. I went there because it was an unmanned store. All ordering is done through a kiosk and food is delivered through a locker-like door in the wall. When you touch the kiosk, the first screen is the goods ordering screen (it's superficial). When you order and wait, your order number will appear when it's ready. If you scan the number tag, your number will appear on the locker screen and when you knock, the door will open. It's an interesting system, but I don't know why it's done like this. The door opens in the middle of the day, and several people can be seen on the inside, coming out and walking back and forth. Is this a store created because the employees are reluctant to meet face-to-face? Since you have to do everything yourself, it feels worse than McDonald's, which brings it to your seat. It's in front of Hongik University entrance, so there are a lot of people, and the taste is just like Luderia.
